_readme: Ready-to-run config for the bundled demo vault. Copy it to config.json in the app folder:
You still need the API key in the environment:
When you move to your own notes, change vault_path and rewrite vault_tiers for your folders.

interview._index_path: The demo owns its own index file, so trying the demo on an existing install cannot overwrite the index built from your real vault.
interview._adjacent_margin: Tightened from the 0.08 default because this vault is small: with only ~100 chunks every unrelated question still scores around 0.60, so the default band swallowed them all and a true no-experience answer was unreachable. Use 0.08 on a real vault.
interview._vault_tiers: Folder -> how the author actually knows it. This is the demo's whole point.
interview._vault_exclude: Dropped from the index entirely. demo-cv.md is here because a CV must NEVER be indexed - it is injected verbatim at answer time, so an indexed second copy would go stale silently. README.md is the vault's own documentation, not anyone's experience.
